title: Plain G1 ECDLP: (4,3) CM-STNFS over Q(zeta_15) with Arch2-Rev-SigmaB-v3 behind a run gate: expected work 2^112.837838138584

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md, RANK-BRIDGE.md) returns scalar x in 0..r-1 from T=[x]P0 via g=e(P0,Q0), z=e(T,Q0)=g^x with fresh-coin boot randomization with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and reached-ideal ensemble H5 (explicitly including de Bruijn local-density correction, closed-form 1D/2D 4-prime 62-bit NTT, fixed-instance H3 4-param hard-capped LA, H-R/H-X rank bridge with live unplanted 4-SM BW + 1D-kernel Hankel+Horner verification, i.i.d. single-cell D_skew=2^21 exact-LLL boot with RET_BOOT=0.50, exact seeded peeling closure h=0.256845, zero-retry deterministic-DAG descent behind a hard combined-log meter t=2^121.4 (Markov <= 0.000112) with unconditional Boole union bound, full 1.0x expected survivor work, multi-factor ECM loops, and 100-round MR), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^110.7297127260+2^66) < 2^112.837838138584 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; 1 core unit = 10 G1 units): an expectation over the challenge and fresh coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every single run. A run gate (u < K = 7952958318221712994, (K/2^64) x 0.904598 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.904598 (unconditional Boole union bound; metered row sum <= 2^124.722652516288 units with combined-log meter t=2^121.4). Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
